name: canvas-fractal-grid

frames.best_why: The pastel gradient is at full strength and the blue cursor halo sits clear of the frame edge.

tagline: A fine dot grid ripples and glows around the moving cursor.
summary: A full-bleed grid of small blue dots over a soft pastel gradient, with a glowing halo and gentle wave that follow the pointer.
appearance: A pale cream page is covered in tiny evenly spaced blue dots. Behind them a blurred pastel blob of pink, peach and lavender drifts, and a small bright blue halo marks the cursor.
behaviour: A soft glow trails the pointer, pushing nearby dots outward in a slow wave; the pastel gradient behind it also shifts colour over a long loop.
search_phrases: dot grid that reacts to the mouse
subtle animated background for a landing page
blue dots over a pastel gradient
website background that follows the pointer
use_when: You need a light, quiet page background with a little life that still leaves text readable.
avoid_when: It is decorative and always animating; on weak devices the per-frame canvas and glow cost adds up.
customise: Dot size, spacing, opacity, colour, wave strength and radius, gradients and noise are props; the pastel palette defaults need source edits.
weight_why: A canvas redraws the dot field every frame, plus gradient and glow layers.

a11y.note: A decorative canvas with no text and no reduced-motion branch; the dot animation and gradient loop always run.

issues: Pointer effects are mouse-only; touch and keyboard users get only the static base.
No reduced-motion handling for the always-running gradient and dots.
The glow follows the pointer anywhere on the page, not just over the component.
polish_why: Soft pastel layering is pleasant, but the dot-grid cursor effect is a familiar pattern.
